reason: The 'honesty gap' at the core of the finding does not hold. (1) The G-A reading was fixed before any G-B-type number existed. 43/62 was committed at 09:51:54Z (e925955/9c85782, 'G-A train run 43/62') and read out again at 10:27:19Z (9826517). The proxy came at 10:45:32Z (1986fb9, wt6 only). G-A is a mechanical count (43 < 60), so a number that appeared 54 min later cannot have shaped it. (2) The proxy was disclosed, not hidden. The 10:52 CONTEXT entry lists it as 'Supporting evidence (info): ... -0.00047 (bootstrap lower -0.00216; clip wins/losses 22/37)', and the stop commit's own message (24dcdea, 10:52:55Z) reads 'G-A fail (43/62), proxy lab -0.00047'. (3) The finding misquotes the record. The phrase 'written before any exp64/G-B number was read' is not in the 10:52 entry, only in the 11:06 entry. There it carries its own scope, 'no exp64 output was on disk', which is accurate: the exp64_a files date from 12:05-12:32Z and exp64_b from about 12:57Z. (4) The proxy is not G-B as pre-registered: G-B means x138/K2 tails, while the proxy used exp39 divnet_rerank tails with no insertion. (5) The line is already closed three times over: the 11:06 'Default = STOP', the round prompt 69a35b4, and this round's task text ('STOPPED, do not re-propose'). A 'FINAL CLOSE' note changes nothing, and declaring the user's post-hoc reopen option 'void' is not a call for an agent to make. The finding is right on two points: no user answer to R8-A2 is logged, and the R8-A2 question text ('nobody has seen G-B lab results yet') was loosely worded while the proxy was already known. Both are minor. The proposed text would add a misleading record: it attributes the phrase to the 10:52 entry and implies the proxy came 7 min before G-A, when it only came before the log line. It would also slip in a new post-deadline item ('cross-copy division import') that has no evidence behind it here. Value on private: exactly 0.
